schema_version: v0 — component-charter shape; migrates into the intention envelope when MAP.md Q6 lands
what: The librarian: owner of the graph trees — db_domain's first real tenant — owner of the EMBED SEAM every tree-writing device composes, and, when its face is whole, a chatbot that is learning always and summarizing when asked. THE EMBED SEAM'S CONTRACT (live.py: embed_via_domain returns the vector alone; embed_metered_via_domain, added 2026-07-29 for ticket a-node-holds-one-claim, returns {vector, tokens} where tokens is the host's own prompt_eval_count and is None on a cache HIT — not-reported is not zero, and inventing a number there would be a proxy metric wearing a measurement's clothes; the vector-only contract is deliberately untouched beside it). v0 is the SPINE (trees.py): a provenance-gated deposit door writing across three tables (cairn_nodes: content + provenance + standing; cairn_embeddings: vector + render_method; per-tree leaf tables: references to both — ticket node-embedding-leaf-separation, paper §3.1/§6.4; the untraceable never lands; every node is born a hypothesis) and proximity walks whose edges are DERIVED from the vectors at walk time via three-table JOIN (leaf→embedding→node), never stored — 'the embedding IS the path through the graph trees.' v0.1 adds THE CORE LOOP (loop.py): always the graph first; when the walk's best cosine misses RESOLUTION_FLOOR, the LLM is asked for NODES (never the answer), they deposit through the same provenance gate, and the ORIGINAL question resubmits — but a node minted during the crossing is DATA, never evidence (the tenure loop's crossing-honesty filter, 2026-08-09: the 2026-07-27 same-request validation clause is SUPERSEDED — the proof the backfill worked COMPLETES at a LATER crossing, when standing structure resolves what a fresh mint may not). The backfill-cache livelock is fixed as physics at that junction: the prompt carries tree_state's digest (same question + changed graph = different cache key) and a round landing nothing fresh terminates loudly — reason 'learned' when the crossing deposited (the graph grew, honestly unresolved), 'no_progress' when it did not, 'exhausted' only for a zero-deposit budget-out. v0.2 adds THE LIBRARY + THE LEARN VERB (library.py): a room in instance-space at the ratified address ~/.cairn/devices/librarian/0/library/ — a shelf of FROZEN copies with stable citable addresses (the register freezes each file's digest; re-shelving same content writes nothing; different content at a standing address is refused — an address must not rot, because provenance anchors point INTO it). The graph is the catalog, not the shelf: LEARN is deposit-only — every passage of a shelved file embeds and deposits through the same provenance gate, anchored {source: library:<address>, passage: p<n>, sha256}, cited by RAW paragraph position so filtering never renumbers. v0.3 adds THE SUMMARIZE VERB (summarize.py): the transducer across the storage axis — a dense region of the graph (the k nearest SOURCE nodes around the question) rendered by the drafting model into articulated, why-carrying prose. The physics: a summary is a VIEW over the graph, never a document the graph forgets — citations are CODE-BUILT from the walked region (the model only marks [n]; an unanchored or minted citation refuses loudly, raw carried whole); the rendered prose DEPOSITS BACK into the same tree, provenance naming the exact nodes it rendered + the region's digest, so follow-ups are walks; the transducer never eats its own output (gather excludes summary-sourced nodes), which makes the verb idempotent — the region rides the render prompt whole, so same question + same source region is a cached render and a duplicate deposit. Depth travels with the artifact (region reached vs tree size). v0.4 adds THE CHAT FACE (chat.py + shim.py): the conversational surface over the loop and the transducer, adding NO third mechanism — LEARNING ALWAYS is every turn crossing the core loop unchanged (walk, backfill, fold-in — the loop ANSWERS from structure), and the reply is that answer ARTICULATED (reconciled 2026-08-09, ticket the-librarian-chats, on Akien's ruling 'the intentions say it should be chatting and it's not'): conversational prose rendered from the walk by ONE generate per resolve turn — the walk rides the render prompt whole and numbered (the transducer's cache mechanism), citations are code-built from the [n] marks (a minted citation refuses loudly, raw carried whole; ZERO anchors are legal — a greeting grounds on nothing, the one clause where chat differs from summarize), and the loop's whole verdict dict rides the reply as data (Law 7: the surface collapses it to a line, the turn record never loses it). Reply prose is runtime state — it never deposits; the transcript is runtime state, the graph is the memory that survives the session. SUMMARIZING WHEN ASKED is the `summarize:` prefix routing to the transducer — the route is PHYSICS (a stated affordance), never an inference spent guessing intent. A verb's loud refusal becomes a legible reply the session survives. THE CARRIER (corrected 2026-07-28): there is ONE web server in the whole system, and the librarian owns a PAGE it displays — the chat window is a surface the base shim class understands: the device DECLARES the chat pane, LibrarianShim rides the roster and STARTS THE DEVICE IF IT IS NOT RUNNING (attaching the live face at the wake), and a POSTed utterance travels web_server → shim.deliver → device.receive as ordinary mail. No chat route, no port, no second door. Live wiring: `python3 -m cairn.devices.librarian.live [query|loop|shelve|learn|summarize]` and `python3 cairn/devices/web_server/listener.py` for the conversation at /device/librarian (all verbs through inference_domain, metered and cached; trees.py, loop.py, library.py, summarize.py and chat.py are import-pure toward host+DB and the proofs pin it — live composition lives in live.py and the shim's wake).
why: Akien, 2026-07-27, verbatim: 'the current goal is the librarian as chat bot, learning, and summarizing. learning always and summarizing when asked' ... 'And he'll already be ready to answer them immediately. This is part of orienting, for anything externally facing.' The core loop he named 'very simple' (Akien, 2026-07-22): a query resolves by traversing the trees — cheap, no inference; on a MISS the LLM supplies the NODES that let the graph resolve, never the answer; the answer always comes from structure, so re-asking is a graph walk. That is Law 1 as a runtime mechanism, and this store is the structure it runs on. The deposit door's provenance gate is the extractor's founding defect carried one layer down: a fabricated attribution in a draft is a bad day; in a graph node it is a permanent resident.

What v0 reuses is Cairn's own: db_domain's owner-gate as the write physics, inference_domain's embed seam as the vector source, the extractor's judged-at-the-door discipline. how_it_learns: Three loops, staged. (1) BUILT NOW, the substrate: every deposit is a learned fact taking structural residence — the graph IS the memory, and a duplicate deposit writing nothing is Law 1 at the door. The LEARN verb (library.py, built 2026-07-27) is this loop's bulk intake: a shelved file folded in passage by passage, deposit-only, every node citing shelf + passage + frozen digest. (2) BUILT 2026-08-09 (ticket the-tenure-loop, Akien's 'persistance!' ruling), the tenure loop — five behaviors, each riding an event the loop already fires, no clock and no daemon anywhere: CROSSING HONESTY (a node minted during a crossing is labeled evidence:False and cannot resolve the question that spawned it — the first touch returns UNRESOLVED with the honest reason 'learned'; validation completes at a LATER crossing); PROVENANCE APPEND (a duplicate deposit lands its incoming provenance as a timestamped attestation on the standing row — corroboration kept, table growth still refused); PROMOTION (cross-question corroboration fires ON the resolution event; PROMOTION_THRESHOLD distinct questions beyond the birth question earn standing='earned'); LAZY DECAY (uncorroborated attestation-less hypotheses older than DECAY_HORIZON fade from evidence at read — a same-question echo never exempts, or the home-field shard would immortalize itself); REFUTATION (built 2026-08-10, ticket revision-with-receipts): a stated correction RETIRES a node — trees.refute flips standing='refuted' and appends {source:'refutation', refuter, evidence, at} in exactly ONE owner-gated update, so the retirement invalidates and never deletes (content, vector and birth provenance stay byte-identical), and every later walk returns the retired node PRESENT, labelled and UNCOUNTED — the refuted clause is evaluated BEFORE the earned pass-through, so a node earned and then refuted is still uncounted. Refutation is an INPUT, never a discovery: cosine finds nodes that are ALIKE, and a statement and its negation are alike, so nothing here detects contradiction — the door is entered by a HAND, through chat's literal 'correct: <node_id> <why>' prefix (one string comparison, zero model calls on the routing path). The standing gate keys on provenance AUTHORITY rather than standing alone, because every node is BORN a hypothesis and a gate keyed on standing would leave Akien's own correction unable to retire an earned node — the gate protecting the corpus from its author (Law 9: a node in the tree is a past artifact, and no past artifact outranks him now). Invalidate-don't-delete is BORROWED from cairn/machines/ruling's supersession door — cited, never imported. Whether standing MOVES under LIVE use is the armed probe's question: probes/standing_moves_under_live_use.py, the-tenure-loop's WATCHME; whether revisions HOLD under live use — exercised at all, adjudicated ever, and not storming — is the second armed probe's, probes/revisions_hold_under_live_use.py, this ticket's WATCHME. (3) BUILT NOW, the core loop itself (loop.py): on a MISS the LLM provides nodes, the graph folds them in and the ORIGINAL question re-resolves — learning always, as the face's standing behavior; measured live 2026-07-27 (first crossing: one backfill, one fresh node, then RESOLVED at 0.8568; second crossing: zero backfills, zero inference in the answer path) — RE-SCOPED 2026-08-09: that first-crossing RESOLVED is exactly the manufactured shape the tenure loop's filter now closes; a first crossing lands UNRESOLVED-'learned' by design, and the second crossing's zero-backfill resolution remains the contract — and the moment validation completes. The SUMMARIZE verb closes a fourth, reflexive loop (built 2026-07-27): the graph keeps its own distillations — every summary deposits back as structure, so what the librarian articulates it also remembers, and a follow-up walks to it instead of re-rendering. The librarian is the component whose learning IS its function; 'it doesn't learn' would be a charter violation here, not a valid answer.

(i) DIAGRAM-SHAPED PASSAGES RANK POORLY: measured 2026-07-27 — the agent-cycle flow diagram (arrows, numbered steps) scored 0.4943 against a prose question it directly answers, UNDER two less-relevant prose passages. Diagram-ish text may want a prose rendering before embedding (a transducer-shaped fix, not a floor fix).

(j) A MALFORMED BACKFILL DRAFT IS CACHED: qwen2.5:7b emitted invalid JSON once; parse_backfill refused loudly with the raw whole (as designed) — but same question + same graph now HITS that cached draft, so the question cannot backfill until the graph changes. Honest per the key physics; if it bites, a retry rides a CHANGED request (the refusal folded into the prompt = a different key), never a cache bypass.
(k) A BINARY SHELVES BUT REFUSES TO LEARN (not utf-8) — the Readings PDFs need a reader in front of the verb; loud refusal today, not a silent skip.

(l) BACKFILL NODES HAVE A HOME-FIELD ADVANTAGE, measured 2026-07-27: on a follow-up question, three labels minted DURING that crossing outranked both the landed summary (4th, 0.5960) and every shelved passage — backfill nodes are generated FROM the question, so they are born question-shaped and win the similarity race for it; the loop can satisfy its own floor with its own fresh mints. Everything stays traceable (source: llm-backfill, standing: hypothesis), so Laws 3/7 hold — but this is the tenure loop's (edge c) sharpest why yet: question-echo nodes must EARN residence by resolving other questions, or expire. SECOND FACE, measured 2026-07-27 through the live chat: asked about the hex payback meter — knowledge the library tree genuinely lacks (it lives in the founding tree) — the loop backfilled three path-shaped mints and RESOLVED at 0.8295 on them: home-field advantage does not just outrank real nodes, it can MANUFACTURE resolution where the graph held nothing, and the mints' content was wrong about the actual idea. Traceable throughout, so the verdict is honest about its sources — but a consumer reading only the verdict line would call that answered.
